MOLECULAR PATHOLOGY REPORT
Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) Analysis

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient: [redacted name]
Age/Sex: 49-year-old female
Medical Record: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Breast tissue
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
HER2 status assessment in breast cancer

TEST PERFORMED
HER2/neu (ERBB2) Gene Amplification by FISH

METHODOLOGY
Interphase FISH analysis was performed using GenProbe XR-2000 ERBB2/SE 17 dual-color probe. This probe hybridizes to the HER2/neu (ERBB2) gene locus at 17q12 (orange signal) and to the chromosome 17 centromere (green signal).

RESULTS

Cells Analyzed: 60
Mean HER2 Copy Number: 6.23 per cell
Mean Chromosome 17 Centromere: 1.73 per cell
HER2/Chr17 Ratio: 3.60

INTERPRETATION: POSITIVE FOR HER2 AMPLIFICATION

The HER2/Chr17 ratio of 3.60 exceeds the threshold of ≥2.0, indicating HER2 gene amplification.
The mean HER2 copy number of 6.23 per cell also meets the alternative criterion of ≥6.0 signals/cell for HER2 positivity.

This result indicates HER2-amplified breast cancer by both ratio and copy number criteria according to ASCO/CAP guidelines.

Pathologist: [redacted name], MD
Board Certified in Molecular Genetic Pathology
